quote: Neural machine translation (NMT) has recently achieved remarkable results... how can we accurately and efficiently translate between a high-monolingual-resource (HMR) and a low-monolingual-resource (LMR) language?
We propose REused-LM (RE-LM), ... to initialize a UNMT system that translates the LMR to the HMR language (and vice versa).
We evaluate NMT models on the dev set every 3000 updates using greedy decoding. Final translations are generated using beam search of size 5. We report de-tokenized BLEU using SacreBLEU.
